name: Sulekha

sources.title: List Your Business — free listing flow starts with a mandatory +91 mobile number; 20,000+ businesses; paid lead/ads model
Homepage — 'List Your Business FREE'; India-focused local services/education directory with some US cities
Batch-provided submission URL — returned HTTP 404 (dead route)

conditions: Business listing is free, but signup requires a +91 Indian mobile number (mandatory, presumably OTP-verified) — effectively gates out non-Indian businesses
Categories are local services and education/training (tuitions, coaching, home services, consultants) — a SaaS product listing only fits if positioned as an India-based service business
Enquiries/leads are monetized — lead pricing varies by service type and location (per site FAQ); listing itself is free
requirements: Indian mobile number (+91) for mandatory verification
A service business that fits one of 1000+ categories (India cities primarily; some US city pages exist)
Business name, service area, service offerings, profile description
preparation: Working +91 mobile number able to receive OTP/SMS
Business details: name, city/locality, categories, service list
workflow: Enter the +91 mobile number and complete verification
Create the business profile: categories, locality preferences, service offerings
Manage via the Sulekha Business app — respond to enquiries and reviews; pause lead flow as needed
watchFor: +91 mobile is mandatory — no non-Indian signup path visible on the listing page
This is a lead-gen marketplace: expect contact from Sulekha sales about paid leads/ads after signup
SaaS products are not a category — only service businesses; shoehorning a software product risks removal
Lead pricing varies by category/city — check inside the Business app before buying leads
countsAsLive: The business profile appears in Sulekha category/city search with name, locality, services and reviews section
unknowns: Whether non-Indian businesses can list on the US city pages (the form only offered +91)
Verification steps beyond mobile OTP (GST/business proof?)
Website link presence and follow/nofollow on the public profile
